_comment: Expert registry. Two categories: 'super' agents are jobs (Consultant, Lawyer, Engineer…) — their `label` IS the role, designed for productivity gains on existing tasks. 'genius' agents are historical figures unlocking creative outputs the user couldn't make alone (DaVinci builds visual universes, Bach composes music, Kubrick directs films, Socrates interviews you to draft new experts) — their `label` is the genius's name. The recruiter (Socrates) is a genius too — he's just shown in a separate 'hire him' CTA in onboarding, which is a UI choice, not a category one. persona = experts/<slug>.md (projected into the workspace AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/… at session start). skills = the portable SKILLs to mount (skills/<name>/SKILL.md → the harness's skill dir); a name not yet vendored under skills/ is silently skipped. kind is informational. The slug (key) is the stable identifier used in personas/skills and never changes. `figure` preserves the historical persona for super agents (used in personas + tooltips). User-created custom experts live in <VAR_DIR>/experts/<slug>.{md,json}.
